title: Antimatter Domains and Cosmic Antimatter
bottleneck: The baryon asymmetry could in principle allow distant antimatter domains, and AMS-02 has reported a handful of anti-helium candidate events that would be smoking guns. The events are few, backgrounds (spallation) are debated, and no gamma-ray signature of matter-antimatter annihilation at domain boundaries has been seen. Even a single confirmed anti-helium nucleus would be inexplicable by known astrophysical processes.
why_it_blocks: Confirmed cosmic anti-helium would overturn the standard baryogenesis narrative entirely. The baryogenesis theories that work on paper would all need rethinking from scratch.
current_state: AMS-02's candidates await confirmation; the collaboration has not claimed discovery, and the events remain unexplained. The collaboration urges caution, and independent confirmation with more statistics is needed before any claim. A discovery would rank among the most significant in particle astrophysics.
